results.name: Seven named benefits share a read-only registry; unknown skins use the brass fallback
Brass adds 20 maximum and starting HP; each other skin starts with 120
Starting another fight replaces the equipped benefit and cannot stack HP or effects
Frost turns a 0.34 second guard into a perfect parry; the base window remains shorter
Obsidian reduces late-parry and exhausted-guard damage by 20%, rounded up
Verdigris regenerates stamina 30% faster while resting, guarding and attacking
Ember breaks weak guards for 35% more damage, including the combo bonus
Ember cannot damage a fully prepared guard by attacking outside recovery
Royal spends exactly 25% less stamina on manual dodges
Royal discounts normal and heavy blocks, automatic dodges, perfect and late parries
Royal preserves attack costs and the energy drained when Rex parries the player
Solar heals six HP on a perfect parry and caps healing at its current maximum
Solar never revives a fallen knight or heals after the fight is over
Healing a finishing Solar parry still ends only when Rex HP reaches zero
Only the equipped skin applies; merely owning all seven adds no stacked benefits
Collection and HUD describe the same selected benefit from the shared data
Reward reveals its actual benefit and equipping applies it on the next fight
Collection handlers cannot change benefits during active or paused combat
The mandatory prologue still consumes 18 visible seconds before benefits can fight
Natural AI stays spaced and remains beatable with the new starter benefit
